notes.title: v0.8 now on STEAM 🥳
notes.content:
[h1]TWEAKS[/h1]
- The lava in the game no longer kills directly, but deals damage as long as you stay in it.
- A new type of EXP and Gold has been added.
- Survival time increased to 25-30 minutes on an average map.
- The healing value of food has been increased. And a new food was added.
- Some UI adjustments have been made.
- New enemies have been added.

We made more balancing decisions in this update. We are looking forward to your feedback.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44423872/4712b3859591561e2df7a575aec0dc69ec6b7e27.jpg[/img]

notes.title: v0.7.2 Update is alive NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44423872/ce1e41964dd85606877b0a47d0b8c2796152cabf.jpg[/img]

[b]We brought some balancing and some innovations in this update 🔃.[/b]

- We found that the cost of captives is very high and it is very difficult for players to purchase and play with Epic level captives. For this reason, we divided the captives into 4 classes. These are: Ordinary, Rare, Unusual, Epic. Those in the Rare class have been updated in the store as 5000 Captive Points, those in the Unusual class as 15000 Captive Points, and those in the Epic class as 35000 Captive Points 💸.

- The abilities of some captives have been adjusted 🤹🏻.
    - Bull: Regenerates its own health by dropping fire embers every 8 seconds 🔥.
    - Cloner Wizard: Opens a portal that melts enemies every 5 seconds. This portal is said to carry the creatures of Hellrand 🪄.

- New abilities added 🥳.
    - Lightning Strike, this ability can now both be accelerated and its damage increased ⚡.
    - Death Circle, the area covered by this ability can now grow larger 🔵.

notes.title: Ancestor Wood Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44423872/619c375737793a7b21477fa47eac191674c246c7.png[/img]

[h1][b]v0.7.1 Update[/b][/h1]
* With this update, a new map, a new mode, new captives and new systems are added to the game.

[h2][b]New Captives[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44423872/c1a77eaa3b4baf10451d060eed9c0195edf05910.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44423872/ccd5a40b43f64b95378b00ecbc7df7ec84d5e80b.png[/img]

[h3]Eltaor is a forest elf who can use forbidden books.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44423872/caddb3354a5b65f0ee1440c0543a9277074fbf6e.png[/img]

[h3]King Tholder, as ruler of Cratland, has come to end the spell.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44423872/17e6cd68222819e56aa173adffb7d76f68b1ef4b.png[/img]

[h3]Although there is not much information about him, it is known that he is a bounty hunter.[/h3]

[h3]Protector of the wood elves.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44423872/cd126b8b6366c60b09e01f204132b7760f8ea55f.png[/img]

[h3]Half wolf half elf.[/h3]

[h1][b]Other Updates[/b][/h1]

[list]
[*] A new map called Sewer has been introduced, which players at Diamond 3 rank level can enter.

notes.title: Impact: Fall Of Cratland Update now on Steam
notes.content:
[b]"Update 0.7.0 comes with a lot of madness.[/b]

We are starting a new season in this update. Introducing "Fall Of Cratland"! With the Fall Of Cratland update, new captives, new events, new abilities, new items, new costumes and new interfaces are added to IImpact. And with the collaboration of Running With Scissors, Postal Dude, the popular character of the Postal series, is also added to Impact as a captive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44423872/76ed4795b26fda347ae747553d045feae3872389.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44423872/99e8888796357eee09fa5879764e86f6b144c447.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44423872/632f75438bb729cd67cc30e7dc7c9638dbc42dcf.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44423872/22fda37d5df6d408ce0f9ee2a1d933f86d53fd66.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44423872/0aba16f97b0218de225d8c75b87a7c36e7b4911f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44423872/c935a39c2311da6cca533cbbbcf5db02fdcdc9b4.png[/img]

[b]Lambert's Adventure[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44423872/ff8f72f307750c6a74497b16905cd65461dc1ccc.png[/img]

Lambert was the son of the king of Cratland. Lambert also had two siblings (Princess and Terblam). But Terblam had a disease never seen before. The disease was consuming Lambert's brother. Lambert was trained in black magic at a young age, at the behest of his father. When Lambert turned 14, he realized the truth about his brother's illness. This so-called disease was actually a curse.

[b]v0.7.0 Tweaks and fixes[/b]

notes.title: V0.6.2.4 HOTFIX & Improvements
notes.content:
[b]Bu güncellememizde oyundaki bazı hatalar giderildi ve bazı özellikler eklendi.[/b]

* Tüccar glitch düzeltildi.

[b]Getirilen Güncellemeler[/b]

* Oto aim aldığınız enemy üzerlerine indicator eklendi.

* Enemyler spawn olunca indicator eklendi.

* Görsel iyileştirmeler yapıldı.

notes.title: Try Out The Latest Demo for Impact During Next Fest!
notes.content:
[h3]We are taking part in Steam Next Fest October 2023 Edition. You can play the latest demo for [i]Impact[/i] during the festival![/h3]

We've been working non-stop to get ready for this festival and it is finally here! We're very excited to be sharing the most up to date version of our game with you. We're looking forward to hearing all of your feedback and we hope you enjoy what we have on offer with this demo for Next Fest!

Make sure to check out all the other great games taking part in this great event after playing [i]Impact[/i]!

Steam Next Fest October 2023 edition runs October 9 at 10:00 AM PDT (UTC-7) to October 16 at 10:00 AM PDT (UTC-7).
